audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer never names a Zaahen ability — the focus, the loading screen, the cooldown block and eight other lines all say the literal word 'Ultimate'. It also picks the wrong ability as matchup-defining.
audit.why: His threatening cooldown is not the 110s ultimate; it is Aureate Rush (E), a dash on 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s that deals max-health damage. Gating your step-ups on a 110s cooldown while a 10s dash is what actually punishes you is advice that gets a Karma killed. Ability names come from the repo's own interaction data: The Darkin Glaive (Q), Aureate Rush (E), Grim Deliverance (R).
audit.corrected: Rewrote focus, tldr, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5] around Aureate Rush's 10s cooldown, plus the Darkin Glaive auto-reset tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every level row read Zaahen, including level 1 and level 6, while the whys on those same rows say 'Level 1 is even' and 'Level 6 is close'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen, Zaahen, Skill, Zaahen, Zaahen — matching the prose. A 45.13% win rate over 2433 games is a losing lane but not a 0-for-7 one.
audit.corrected: Rows 0 and 4 set to Skill on both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[] had only 3 entries (packet defect) and the full-layer phase whys were Karma boilerplate about owning a toll booth she does not own here.
audit.why: The missing fourth spike is his two-item state, where Grim Deliverance heals him for a portion of the damage dealt and the side-lane duel becomes unwinnable. The phase whys ignored that his Q both heals and knocks up on recast.
audit.corrected: Created spikes[3].text and spikes[3].when with 'before': null, and rewrote phases[0..6].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal advice anywhere, and nothing warning against armour.
audit.why: Zaahen heals off both The Darkin Glaive and Grim Deliverance, and Aureate Rush deals max-health damage, so stacking resistances misreads the trade.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal added to breakdown.cooldowns and the max-health note to report[5].

notes: Confidence is Medium on the ability names: the kit file for Zaahen carries no names, only slots, so Q/E/R names (The Darkin Glaive, Aureate Rush, Grim Deliverance) are taken from the repo's own missing-interactions headlines. His W has no name in either source, so I never named it. Everything numeric comes from the kit itself. The full layer previously treated his 110s ultimate as the gating cooldown when the 10s E dash is what actually punishes a step-up — that was the substantive error here.
